build_GroundingDINO_detector: build a GroundingDINO detector model with a language model config for open-set object detection
run_get_tokens_and_prompts: run get_tokens_and_prompts to tokenize a caption string and extract entity tokens and prompts
run_get_positive_map: run get_positive_map to create a positive token map from tokenized text and entity spans
run_forward_transformer: run forward_transformer to process image features and text dict through the encoder-decoder pipeline
run_predict: run predict to detect objects in images using text prompts and return predicted instances with label names
